title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've gotta start getting ready for first period... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(What's gotten into Saki and Otori?
They look excited about something...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Maybe I can help out too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, for real?!
With you helping out, I'd feel sooo confident about this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's give Shiho the best birthday ever next week!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My birthday...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They must be planning a surprise...or trying to.
Do they realize I can hear everything...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! We can do a BIIIG celebration with everyone in class and—
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't even think about it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! It's Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You... You overheard all of that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
When you're being that loud, how could I not?
But more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm happy you two want to celebrate my birthday, but I'm not sure about the whole class—

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Wait! Hinomori, is it your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh... No, it's actually next week...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: So soon! Happy early birthday!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-Sorry Saki. Everyone noticed because of me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, it's my fault too! I was also being loud. But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that the cat's out of the bag, we should lean in and make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Then it's time to call a strategy meeting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Strategy meeting...?
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: ...and so now, the two of them are going all out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. So Saki and Emu are planning something?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And Saki made this whole speech, like, “On our honor as your self-appointed birthday party planner and the class representative, we pledge to give you the best birthday ever!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hahaha... Come to think of it, Saki was particularly energetic at lunch today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I don't think you have any reason to worry. With those two working together, I'm sure it will be a very fun day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, sure...
I just hope they don't overdo it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey guys! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speak of the devil!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? You were talking about me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. We were wondering how you're going to celebrate Shiho's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! As it happens, I was discussing that with Emu just earlier!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We decided we're gonna get advice from Tsukasa on our next day off!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fr-From Tsukasa...? Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm surely sure!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We made a pledge to make your birthday fun, and we're gonna keep it! Just you wait, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Seeing Saki this fired up sort of makes me want all of us to do something special for Shiho too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! We should come up with some amazing way to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I agree, but you do realize Shiho is standing right here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone's getting so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I appreciate them going out of their way for me, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What is this birthday even going to be like...?)
